messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up: planning a Vault auth mode change and KMS-backed audit encryption in staging tomorrow. Aim: switch from token-engine to k8s/GCP IAM bound auth for pods + enable the audithook to encrypt logs with KMS key `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/audit-wrap-2026`. Window: 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC (canary) -> 03:00 UTC full. Need RBAC review, KMS IAM grant, and a short-lived token rotation list. Who can own what?

ryan: I can own the k8s RBAC changes. Ping me the exact Role/Binding diff. Prefer we scope the canary to namespace `staging-ingest` first.

priya: I'll take KMS IAM bindings. Plan to create a dedicated service account `vault-audit-writer@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`. Will add a Terraform PR with `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = false }` for now so we can test in staging.

moss: Oncall for the window. If anything goes sideways we revert the Vault auth mount and re-enable token engine — I have revert manifests in the runbook. Also will run live `vault status` checks + consumer tail.

chris: We'll need to rotate these long-lived credentials prior to cutover: `ci-deploy-token`, `backup-service-key`, and `legacy-ingest-api`. I'll produce a short list and owners by EOD. Reminder: rotate only after we approve the canary results.

liza: Quick RBAC diff suggestion: tighten the `secrets` verbs and add a dedicated `audit-writer` SA with minimal perms. Example snippet: 
```diff
- kind: ClusterRole
- rules:
- - apiGroups: [""]
-   resources: ["secrets"]
-   verbs: ["*"]
+ kind: ClusterRole
+ rules:
+ - apiGroups: [""]
+   resources: ["secrets"]
+   verbs: ["get","list"]
+ - apiGroups: [""]  # audit shims
+   resources: ["pods/log"]
+   verbs: ["get"]
```

ops-bot: SYSTEM: Scheduled maintenance window created: 2026-04-02 02:00-03:00 UTC — stakeholders: @moss @ryan @priya.

elaine: Checklist I'm locking in here: 
- By 20:00 UTC prior day: publish svcaccount list + long-lived token owners.
- Priya: create KMS IAM PR and run encrypt/decrypt test in staging.
- Ryan: open RBAC PR and request maria/security review.
- Canary (02:00 UTC, 30m): enable k8s/GCP IAM auth for `staging-ingest` only and enable audithook encryption for that traffic.
- Monitor: Vault audit consumer, auth failures (401 spikes), and KMS decrypt error metrics.
- Full (03:00 UTC): if canary good, rollout cluster-wide.
- Post-cutover (24h): rotate long-lived tokens and schedule key rewrap if no regressions.

ryan: For detection queries, use this ELK snippet to count auth failures: 
```
index=audit-vault-* AND json.event_type:auth AND json.status:401
| stats count() by json.client_token
```

priya: Note about KMS: don't rotate the wrapping key during the cutover. We'll schedule rewrap 48h after if everything is green. Rewrap during cutover increases risk of KMS-permission-induced failures.

moss: Rollback criteria: >4% auth failure rate sustained for 5m OR >0.5% KMS decrypt errors in consumer. If hit, revert auth method + disable audithook encryption.

elain e: (typo) will fix runbook link. Actual runbook: https://wiki.redwood/infrastructure/runbooks/vault-k8s-iam-kms-cutover . Add exact `kubectl`/`vault` commands there.

chris: I'll publish the token list now: owners for rotation: `ci-deploy-token` -> @devops, `backup-service-key` -> @dbs, `legacy-ingest-api` -> @ingest-team. Will coordinate rotation windows with owners.

liza: One more: SDK teams may see auth header differences. @devx please add smoke test that mints a pod-identity bound token and validates Vault login.

elaine: thanks all — I'll update thread with PR links once opened. Ping @moss if you need immediate rollback during canary.
